Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

pay — to give money for something. Example: Can I pay by card?
cash — coins and notes. Example: I pay in cash.
card — a plastic card used for payment. Example: Can I pay by card?
receipt — the paper proving you paid. Example: Here is your receipt.
change — the money you get back. Example: Here is your change.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Can I pay by card?
• Do you take cash?
• Here is your receipt.
• Here is your change.
• Keep the change.
